mechanics.name: Wake Up!
mechanics.currentEffect: When all Generators are completed, you see the Auras of Exit Gate Switches. While opening an Exit Gate, other Survivors see your Aura. You open Exit Gates 8/9/10% faster, plus an additional 20% faster for each other Survivor alive.
activation: The self-Aura sharing and speed bonus apply while you are opening an Exit Gate.
Ends/deactivates when: Exit Gate Switch Aura reading remains available after all Generators are completed.
Ends/deactivates when: Your Aura is shared only while opening an Exit Gate.
mechanics.patchNote: Latest live balance change (10.2.0): Changed Exit Gate opening speed to 8/9/10% plus 20% for each other Survivor alive (was 8/10/12.5% per any Survivor alive); Exit Gate Switch and self-Aura information retained.
mechanics.plainEnglishSummary: After all Generators are done, Exit Gate Switches are revealed, teammates can see you opening a Gate, and your Gate-opening speed scales with other living Survivors.
duration: Exit Gate Switch Aura reveal persists after all Generators are completed.
Your Aura is shared while opening an Exit Gate.
specialInteractions: Gate-opening speed is 8/9/10% plus 20% for each other Survivor alive.

editorial.summary: After all generators are completed, reveal Exit Gates, show teammates your Aura while opening one, and open it up to 70% faster with all four Survivors alive.
useCases: Locate either Exit Gate immediately on indoor or visually confusing maps.
Open a gate much faster while several Survivors remain alive.
Broadcast which gate you are opening so teammates can route toward it.
counters: Provides absolutely no value before all generators are completed.
The speed bonus shrinks as Survivors die.
A match that never reaches powered gates leaves the perk completely unused.
pros: Up to 70% faster gate opening is a major endgame time save.
Global gate information removes navigation uncertainty.
Built-in teammate Aura communication helps Solo Q.
cons: Dead for the entire pre-endgame phase.
Cannot help the team reach the point where it activates.
Less powerful when few Survivors remain alive.
analysis: Wake Up! became even more explosive at a healthy-team endgame. Tier III now gives 10% base gate speed plus another 20% for each other Survivor alive, reaching 70% faster opening with all four Survivors still in the Trial.
That is enough to materially change Killer rotation math. A gate that would normally remain contestable can become nearly finished before the Killer completes a cross-map check.
The information package remains helpful as well: you see Gate Switches and teammates see your Aura while you are opening one, reducing endgame confusion in Solo Q.

The same structural weakness remains absolute. Wake Up! does nothing before all generators are completed. Its live numbers warrant a higher review, but its dead early game still prevents a universal recommendation.
editorial.verdict: A monstrous gate opener in a four-Survivor endgame, now reaching 70% faster. Wake Up! is still dead before the generators finish, but its active payoff is no joke.
